cases.summary: Creates a validated offline implementation plan through discovery.
cases.setup: Use a disposable repository with a small API, tests, no existing specs, and no external image approval.
cases.prompt: Write a plan for adding rate limiting to the API.
expectedBehavior: Discovers planf3 and routes only to create-plan plus the template and inline-SVG subworkflow.
Creates one scoped offline HTML plan with no placeholders or remote resources.
Runs validate_plan.py to success and does not use paid generation.

cases.summary: Updates a prepared plan while preserving append-only metadata.
cases.setup: Provide an independently prepared valid Plan F3 fixture with two phases and populated metadata; include a checksum of unaffected sections.
cases.prompt: Add a rollback phase to specs/rate-limiting.html and preserve the rest of the plan.
expectedBehavior: Routes only to update-plan and validates the starting fixture.
Creates a pre-edit snapshot, adds the scoped phase and amendment, and appends metadata.
Passes validate_plan.py with --previous and preserves unaffected sections.
forbiddenBehavior: Changes unrelated purpose, problem, or solution content.

cases.summary: Builds a prepared plan and maintains validated task state.
cases.setup: Provide an independently prepared valid plan and fixture repository whose phase commands are deterministic and local.
cases.prompt: Build the unfinished phases in specs/rate-limiting.html. Do not open or merge a PR.
expectedBehavior: Routes to build-plan without reading the template.
Validates before execution, updates task states in order, and loops on phase checks.
Appends build metadata and passes post-build validation with a previous snapshot.
forbiddenBehavior: Starts later phases before dependencies pass.
